name: Gojō (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Gojō city emblem in green: a ring with winged horizontal strokes at the hoist, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Gojō, a city in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Gojō city emblem — a ring with winged horizontal strokes at the hoist, like a stylised character
